summary: Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a home-market stock exchange announcement) dated September 30, 2026, providing an update on ordinary share purchases under its Long Term Incentive Plans. The company acquired 3,050,171 ordinary shares since September 18, 2026, including 1,669,211 in the reporting window, at average daily prices between €16.2596 and €16.9399 per share across Euronext, CBOE, Equiduct, and Aquis. This covers incentive plan obligations rather than a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are stated.
